criteria: same original WH type (who or what) but different human question strings
two separate single answer spans, zero-based half-open valid ranges, match source tokens exactly
gold answer surfaces different and each occurs exactly once in same source sentence
no duplicated normalized questions within predicate group
no gold strings or source text exported
scientific_limits: The two questions in a pair are from the same original human annotation worker/assignment, not two independent human raters.
Different gold token spans and strings do not guarantee that referring expressions denote different entities; preserve original QA-SRL span-task semantics.
Question-blind constant-answer policies cannot be fully correct on these strict distinct-string singleton pairs, but a competent question-conditioned syntax/lexical copier might.
